'''Obenth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he attended a party in the [[Nexus Room]] cantina, where he mingled with [[Samara Mindak]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obenth appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Dromund Kaas.
